name: Kaneda Hajime
source:
The protagonist's best friend. They are infamous as a duo.  He is a boisterous person who is always making a fuss.  He is cheerful and active, and although he enjoys deducing things, he is rarely right. 

He is a troublemaker who gets into all sorts of trouble, usually with self-inflicted consequences. However, he often solves problems with his energy. 

[From [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/steal/kin.html]official site[/url]]
